questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Assess ability to translate business impact into technical rollout decisions, including statistical thinking and cost models.

## Key Concepts
- Cost-benefit modeling
- A/B testing & uplift estimation
- Edge compute cost vs latency trade-offs
- Rollout policy and monitoring

## Code Example
```javascript
function shouldRollout(uplift, arpu, users, cost, threshold){
  const revenue = uplift * arpu * users;
  const net = revenue - cost;
  return net >= threshold;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle uplift uncertainty (CI) in decision?
- How would you budget rollouts across regions with variable costs?

}

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to build a complete, quantitative business case for privacy-conscious on-device ML at scale, including regulatory risk, multi-region considerations, and real-world KPIs.

## Key Concepts
- Federated learning with differential privacy
- Edge compute vs. cloud aggregation trade-offs
- Multi-region cost modeling (edge, bandwidth, infra)
- Activation/ARPU uplift vs. risk penalties

## Code Example
```javascript
function breakEven({activationUpliftPct, arpuLift, edgeCost, serverCost, penalty, months}) {
  const revenue = (activationUpliftPct/100) * arpuLift * 1e6 * months;
  const cost = (edgeCost + serverCost) * months + penalty;
  return revenue - cost;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you adjust the model if ARPU uplift is nonlinear?
- Which metrics and signals would trigger a go/no-go decision in production?

## Why This Is Asked

This question probes ability to design and justify moves to a lakehouse architecture, balancing cost, latency, data freshness, and risk in a measurable way.

## Key Concepts

- TCO modeling across storage, compute, and data transfer
- Data freshness vs cost and drift/rollback risk
- Sensitivity analysis and decision rules

## Code Example

```javascript
function npv(cashFlows, rate) {
  return cashFlows.reduce((acc, v, i) => acc + v / Math.pow(1+rate, i+1), 0);
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you measure and model data drift in this context?
- What rollout milestones and metrics would trigger a rollback or full migration?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design a cost-benefit framework around privacy-preserving client-side data handling, including on-device processing, user consent, and regulatory considerations. It also probes rollout planning and measurable business impact across multiple platforms.

## Key Concepts
- On-device processing (WASM), privacy by design, consent-driven telemetry
- PII redaction, signature of data blobs, minimal data transfer
- Compliance budgeting, audit readiness, regional rollout
- Metrics: CPU, energy, storage, blob size, consent rate, support load impact

## Code Example
```javascript
function redactPII(payload){
  const s = JSON.stringify(payload);
  return s.replace(/"(name|email|phone|address)":"[^"]+"/g, '"$1":"REDACTED"');
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you model break-even sensitivity to consent-rate changes?
- What fallbacks exist if device performance degrades on older hardware?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Assesses translating risk constraints into a CB analysis for edge workloads, balancing latency, privacy, and regulatory risk.

## Key Concepts

- Edge decisioning, policy caches, TTL, delta updates
- Data residency, privacy penalties, regulatory risk
- Latency targets, offline/online mode

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo-CBA calculator
function cba(modelCost, savings, opex, capex, horizon) {
  const net = (savings - opex - capex) * horizon - modelCost;
  return { net, roi: net / (capex + modelCost) };
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you handle conflicting regional policies at the registry level?
- What metrics would you collect to validate the 18-month targets?
